milestone: SeLinOS objectd fixed inventory reservation M1

contract.request: Only a two-word RESERVE request for slot 1 is accepted.
contract.state: The first exact request transitions objectd-local state from FREE to RESERVED; the second exact request returns EBUSY and leaves state RESERVED.
contract.authority: Root delegates only the client endpoint to objectd and its probe. Objectd receives no allocator, task object, VSpace, device, IRQ, DMA, PCI, I/O or IOSpace authority.

required_markers: SeLinOS objectd M1: fixed inventory slot 1 reserved without object allocation.
SeLinOS objectd M1: duplicate slot 1 reservation rejected with EBUSY.
SeLinOS objectd M1: fixed inventory reservation-state proof passed.
SeLinOS objectd M1 probe: one-slot reserve then EBUSY passed.
forbidden_markers: SeLinOS objectd M1: malformed reservation rejected.
SeLinOS objectd M1 probe: reservation sequence rejected.

not_claimed: TCB, CSpace, VSpace, endpoint, notification or fault-endpoint allocation
capability lease transfer, revocation, reuse, teardown or dynamic task creation
Linux clone, fork, pthread, process exit, wait, signal or futex semantics
device, IRQ, DMA, PCI, I/O or IOSpace authority
